top_findings: Contradictory claims: Free vs. Paid, EPG availability, and live vs. coming soon platforms
Trust & Security: APK hosted on unbranded URL without version/hash metadata
Content Cannibalization: 26 scaled blog posts published rapidly with overlapping topics and no author
Image Performance: next/image missing sizes prop, causing LCP bloat
quick_wins: Fix duplicated brand names on blog titles and set og:type='article'
Remove dead 'Become a Reseller' CTA and unsubstantiated claims

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Verified: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonicals, HTTPS redirects
HTML lang attribute correctly set to 'en'

findings.title: Nested Anchor Bug
findings.description: HTML nested-anchor bug detected in the Smarters article.
findings.recommendation: Fix the nested anchor structure to ensure valid HTML.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Good initial text volume on the homepage

findings.title: UX & Messaging Contradictions
findings.description: Contradictory claims regarding pricing (free vs 7-day trial), EPG features, and platform availability.
findings.recommendation: Harmonize messaging and publish a clear pricing page.

findings.title: Scaled Content Issues
findings.description: Blog contains 26 quickly published, overlapping posts with no named author or bio.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate overlapping posts into pillar pages and add author profiles.

findings.title: Unbranded APK Hosting
findings.description: The Android APK is served from a generic r2.dev bucket instead of a branded domain.
findings.recommendation: Move APK to downloads.vantoplayer.com and display version/SHA-256 metadata.

categories.name: Images & Performance
what_works: Lazy loading is correctly implemented on most below-fold images

findings.title: Missing sizes Prop
findings.description: w=3840 image URLs point to a missing sizes prop, increasing LCP and page weight.
findings.recommendation: Ensure sizes prop is configured on next/image elements.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Move APK to branded domain with metadata
Fix next/image sizes prop and nested-anchor bug

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Consolidate 26 overlapping blog posts into pillar pages

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monitor Search Console for correct indexation of consolidated blog content
